findings_and_corrections.finding: Accepted source-row raw/ready/excluded counters could disagree with the individually hashed screening receipt.
findings_and_corrections.correction: Require exact receipt/accepted-row counter agreement and input = retained + removed.

findings_and_corrections.finding: Boolean and negative counts could satisfy loose equality checks.
findings_and_corrections.correction: Require nonnegative integers, excluding booleans, in both schemas of current counters.

findings_and_corrections.finding: An empty or noncanonical removed ID could enter the exclusion set.
findings_and_corrections.correction: Require the same canonical nNNNN ID syntax used by report citations.

findings_and_corrections.finding: A duplicate ID within a legacy reason list was silently deduplicated.
findings_and_corrections.correction: Reject duplicates within each legacy list; preserve legitimate overlap between semantic and timing reasons.

findings_and_corrections.finding: The current screening receipt raw-source hash was not compared with the accepted row.
findings_and_corrections.correction: Require unreviewed_sha256 to equal accepted raw_sha256.

preserved_gates: Both current accepted hash bindings must match each exact news_ready receipt.

A partial or missing schema has no empty-map fallback.
All23 current receipt hashes participate in the final stability check.
